Prior single-signal against-fires and giveback spikes (up to 22%) were tolerated since price kept making new favorable highs and ER10/hurst stayed elevated; the exit trigger was the conjunction of all three fire families plus a clear multi-timeframe deceleration (negative, significant lambda_hat on 15s/1m) rather than any one signal alone. Next time I'd watch for this same triple-alignment + ER10 breakdown pattern earlier as the primary reversal signature, and treat isolated single against-fires as noise unless giveback also compounds across consecutive frames.
